already_done.text: Connection-release fix written, merged, and covered by a regression test.

assumptions.text: The payment webhook timeout is a separate issue from the pool exhaustion (it does not correlate with the pool pattern).
Initial hypothesis: the pricing service deploy four days ago caused the 500 errors.

constraints.text: Change freeze: code changes only in the checkout service repository during the incident.
No rollback of any service without evidence that the rollback target caused the problem.

decisions.rationale: Code inspection found connections leaking on error paths in report generation, exhausting the 50-connection pool under load.
decisions.text: Fix the report-generation path to release connections via a context manager on all paths.

decisions.rationale: Log timestamps show errors began three days before the pricing deploy; the deploy is exonerated.
decisions.text: Do not roll back the pricing service.

decisions.rationale: Verify the fix holds under real traffic before closing the incident.
decisions.text: Keep the incident open and monitor error rates after the fix.

errata.note: Parity phrase 'pricing deploy' corrected to 'pricing service deploy', the scenario's own term, used by both the journal and the summary. Content was present in substance; the phrase list asserted a wording the sources do not use. Recorded before continuations.

evidence.text: Error logs show the 500s began seven days ago, three days before the pricing deploy.
Error rate correlates with report-generation traffic, not with pricing calls.

evidence.source: code inspection of the checkout service
evidence.text: Report-generation path leaked database connections on error paths; pool of 50 connections is exhausted under load.
A rare payment webhook timeout, about 1 in 2,000 calls, continues and is unexplained.

must_not_state.text: The pricing service deploy caused the 500 errors.
Proposing to roll back the pricing service.
The cause of the webhook timeout is known (it is not).
The incident is fully resolved and can be closed.

next_actions.text: Monitor checkout error rates under load to confirm the fix holds.
Investigate the payment webhook timeout as a separate thread.

objective: Diagnose intermittent checkout 500 errors, fix the true cause, and avoid acting on an exonerated hypothesis.

open_questions.text: What causes the rare payment webhook timeout? Unexplained.

revision_chains.authoritative: Connection pool exhaustion from leaked connections in the report-generation path
revision_chains.original: Leading hypothesis: the pricing service deploy caused the errors
revision_chains.provenance: log timestamp analysis and code inspection
revision_chains.revised: Root cause: connection pool exhaustion from leaked connections in the report-generation path
revision_chains.what_changed: The accepted root cause changed from the pricing deploy to the connection leak
